title: generateCode
responsibility: Plans and writes categorized model or scaffold files, preserving overwrite protection, project eligibility, dependencies and public library exports.

inputs.name: generateModel.input
inputs.description: Model name, field specifications and adapter (d1/sqlite/postgres), with optional category, force and root; omitted root uses the current directory and omitted force protects changed files.

inputs.name: generatePiece.input
inputs.description: Scaffold kind and name, with optional category, responsibility, root, force and component level; root defaults to the current directory and force is disabled when omitted.

inputs.name: renderGenerateResult.result
inputs.description: Generation outcome containing scaffold kind/name, per-file statuses and whether the public library exports changed.

inputs.name: generationGroup.root
inputs.description: Project directory used to load the revision taxonomy and resolve explicit or inferred responsibility categories.

inputs.name: generationGroup.input
inputs.type: { name: string; group?: string; responsibility?: string }
inputs.description: Code name plus optional explicit group and responsibility; a categorized project requires one unambiguous category.

inputs.name: saveGenerationGroup.root
inputs.description: Generation root used to report the taxonomy file path relative to the caller.

inputs.name: saveGenerationGroup.selection
inputs.description: Selected category and taxonomy owner; omitted selection or an existing category returns no writes.

inputs.name: groupedFiles.files
inputs.description: Planned source and test files whose paths and module references must move together.

inputs.name: groupedFiles.group
inputs.description: Optional category ID; omission preserves original paths and contents.

inputs.name: groupedExports.plans
inputs.description: Public export plans to retarget to the grouped generated files.

inputs.name: groupedExports.paths
inputs.description: Original-to-grouped source path map from the same planned generation.

inputs.name: assertUniqueGroupedNames.root
inputs.description: Project directory searched for existing declarations in the chosen category.

inputs.name: assertUniqueGroupedNames.group
inputs.description: Chosen category; omission skips the categorized duplicate-name check.

inputs.name: assertUniqueGroupedNames.files
inputs.description: Planned source files to check against same-name files already in the category.

inputs.name: groupedImports.contents
inputs.description: Source text whose module addresses and declared atom-library path are rewritten; ordinary strings remain intact.

inputs.name: groupedImports.before
inputs.description: Original repository-relative source file path used to resolve old module addresses.

inputs.name: groupedImports.after
inputs.description: Destination repository-relative source path used to render new relative addresses.

inputs.name: groupedImports.paths
inputs.description: Original-to-destination path map used to follow generated source moves.

inputs.name: groupedSpecifier.specifier
inputs.description: Relative module specifier; framework $types addresses and trailing directory slashes retain their supported spelling.

inputs.name: groupedSpecifier.before
inputs.description: Original source file path from which the specifier resolves.

inputs.name: groupedSpecifier.after
inputs.description: Destination source file path from which the returned relative specifier resolves.

inputs.name: groupedSpecifier.paths
inputs.description: Original-to-destination source path map; unmatched targets keep their resolved destination.

outputs.name: generateModel
outputs.description: Promise of the generated model name/kind, actual file-write statuses and whether SDK exports changed.

outputs.name: generatePiece
outputs.description: Promise of the generated scaffold name/kind, actual file-write statuses and whether SDK exports changed.

outputs.name: renderGenerateResult
outputs.description: Human-readable generation summary and per-file create/skip/overwrite lines.

outputs.name: generationGroup
outputs.description: Selected taxonomy owner/category and whether it must be added; undefined for an uncategorized legacy project without an explicit choice.

outputs.name: saveGenerationGroup
outputs.description: Promise of the taxonomy file write, or an empty list when the selected category is already recorded or absent.

outputs.name: groupedFiles
outputs.description: Original-to-destination path map and planned files with rewritten module references; does not write them.

outputs.name: groupedExports
outputs.description: Export plans rewritten against the grouped source path map.

outputs.name: assertUniqueGroupedNames
outputs.description: Returns no data after validating uniqueness, or throws before generation writes start.

outputs.name: groupedImports
outputs.description: Source text with only module/atom-library address edits applied in reverse source order.

outputs.name: groupedSpecifier
outputs.description: Relative module address from the destination source, retaining explicit extensions and directory slashes.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects unsafe names, fields, unsupported adapters/scaffolds/levels, ambiguous categories, duplicate declarations and refused overwrites before the affected write.

errors.name: Generation boundary failure
errors.description: Filesystem, dependency installation, taxonomy loading and public-export update failures propagate; earlier successful writes are not presented as an atomic transaction.
